facts.value: ASU offers 400+ graduate degree programs on four campuses, through ASU Online and at locations throughout Arizona, California and more. ASU graduate programs are highly ranked by esteemed publications including U.S. News & World Report.

facts.value: After you submit your ASU application, log in to My ASU or your application portal to check your application status, review missing items and see what to do next.

facts.value: Use your portal to confirm that ASU received your application, see whether transcripts or other documents are missing and track updates to your admission decision.

facts.value: If your status shows missing transcripts or materials, follow the instructions in your portal and submit the required items as soon as possible.
